articles.title: "Grand Sale Bazaar 2026" Officially Opens
articles.summary: PR Newswire: "Grand Sale Bazaar 2026" Officially Opens. Organized by Exhibition Group, the "Grand Sale Bazaar 2026" opens today and runs until January 19 (Friday to Monday) at Hall 5,7,9 of AsiaWorld-Expo, marking a new annual mega event combining shopping and entertainment in Hong Kong. articles.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Wavers Near Record Highs; Nvidia Regains Key Level (Live Coverage)
articles.mainIdea: Stock Market Today: Dow Wavers Near Record Highs; Nvidia Regains Key Level (Live Coverage)
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: Stock Market Today: Dow Wavers Near Record Highs; Nvidia Regains Key Level (Live Coverage). Futures for the Dow Jones Industrial Average and other major stock indexes were mostly higher Friday, as Wall Street looked to finish out the week on a high note. An early winner was Nvidia, which rose on the stock market today after making a bullish move above a key level Thursday.
